correctness.rationale: The explicit Cayley graph is reconstructed exactly. Its 200 nonempty independent faces have face vector \((16,72,96,16)\). An 88-pair discrete-Morse matching is checked against all 496 Hasse covers; the complete Morse orientation is acyclic and leaves one critical 0-cell and twenty-three critical 2-cells. A separate mod-2 chain computation has boundary ranks \((15,57,16)\) and Betti vector \((1,0,23,0)\). Hence the claimed wedge follows.

value.rationale: The Shrikhande graph is a canonical exceptional strongly regular graph, not an arbitrary finite example. Its exact independence-complex homotopy type provides a natural topological invariant of a standard object that shares \((16,6,2,2)\) with the \(4\times4\) rook graph, and the explicit finite Morse certificate is a useful benchmark for graph-complex topology.
